expect.offline: The five MySQL nodes are pins (no MySQL sidecar, P99), so each returns its rows whatever the SQL says. Date & Time reads the run's own clock, so previousMonth and year in the agent's prompt come from when the bench runs, not from the trigger item. The agent's report is a model reply (Gemini 2.5 Pro exp, with Calculator and Think tools in process); the email body is that reply. After the email the Wait (1 minute, the v1.1 default amount) is shortened to 1 second by config/3617.json (time compression)
